release_manifest.note: this run checked listed names and byte sizes; it did not recompute SHA-256 digests

metadata.feature_time_cutoff: two complete integer-second Game Clock bins before the shot row's recorded Clock
metadata.grouped_evaluation: leave-one-game-out, ten anonymized games, no hyperparameter tuning
metadata.permission: user confirmed separate written permission; permission document not inspected or copied
metadata.shot_location_features: shot event release coordinates are included; coordinate-axis orientation is not assumed beyond absolute coordinates

definitions.any_followup_shot_within_5s: next Shot or Goal by either team within 5 integer game-clock seconds before a stop
definitions.goal_from_attempt: Goal event versus Shot event; all attempts included; Detail_2 shot destination is excluded from features
definitions.recovery_within_3s: first Puck Recovery event within 3 integer game-clock seconds after the attempt, before a stop, another shot, or possession event
definitions.same_team_followup_shot_within_5s: next Shot or Goal by the original shooting Team within 5 integer game-clock seconds before a stop or opposing possession event
definitions.same_team_recovery_within_3s: recovery label above; 1 only when recovery Team equals shooting Team, 0 for opponent recovery or none
